How to Apply Email your resume to info@skarion.com Email Subject: Application Engineering Intern | Your Name Important: You must email your resume to info@skarion.com . Please answer the following questions in the body of your email: A candidate has 70 percent of the requirements mentioned in a job description, but is missing two preferred skills. We are looking for the customer-facing technologist who will own the Bangladesh customer relationship from day one . This is a technologist-in-the-customer-room role. You work alongside sales — you are not sales. You are the person whose presence makes the technical conversation credible: the one who can demo the platform, answer the deep "can it do X?" questions, translate compliance language into product capability, and own the customer relationship once the deal is signed. This is the role for someone who: - Sits next to the CEO (and eventually the sales team) on customer calls as the local technical voice — grounding the conversation in what Anqa actually does. - Owns the customer technical relationship after the deal is signed (we are a global team and you will not be on your own). - Builds the self-service infrastructure (knowledge base, runbooks, in-product help) that lets the platform support itself. - Triages tier 1 technical when it does land, and becomes the loudest customer voice in the engineering room. --- What You Will Do Customer engagement (50%) — working alongside sales, as the technical voice - Join customer meetings with banks, NBFIs, and payment companies in Bangladesh alongside the CEO (and the sales team as we grow it). Sales drives the commercial conversation; you bring the technical credibility. The two of you walk in together. - Own customer kickoff, onboarding, and the ongoing technical relationship for each new account. - Be the voice in the room when a customer says "can it do X?" — and translate that back to product and engineering accurately. - Demo the platform yourself when the conversation calls for it. Self-service infrastructure (30%) - Build the customer knowledge base from zero. - Author the customer-facing runbooks, FAQs, and in-product help so the same question gets answered once and the answer scales. - Identify what should be self-service vs human, and design the split. - Work with engineering to flag where the product should explain itself better. Technical triage (20%) - You reproduce, diagnose, and hand to engineering with a clear write-up. - Read application logs, run basic database queries, follow what the platform is doing. - Verify fixes before they ship to customers. --- The Stack You Will Touch Your job is to know the product, explain it, diagnose it, and document it. - React + Next.js — browser debugging, basic UI flow tracing - PostgreSQL — read queries, log analysis - Python / FastAPI — read service logs, follow application logic - GitHub — issue tracking, repo collaboration - REST APIs — understand how front-end talks to back-end - A ticketing + knowledge base platform** — Jira Service Management or similar (we will choose with you) --- Who You Are - > 4–6 years across technical support, customer success, solutions engineering, sales engineering, or similar mid-career customer-facing technical roles. You hold the technical line without overcomplicating, and translate compliance language into product capability. - Technically credible — you can debug a UI flow, read application logs, run basic SQL, and follow Python logic. You need to know what the product is doing to support it. - Strong written and verbal English. Bangladeshi compliance officers and regulators expect formality and clarity. - You want the customer-facing role. Career-wise you are aiming at solutions leadership, customer engineering leadership, or eventually a country GM seat. - Self-directed. You will define how customer engagement runs in Bangladesh as much as execute it. --- This Is NOT For You If - You need a salary from day one. This role is equity in the company plus a path to salary as the pipeline converts. - You want to be a salesperson with a quota — this is a technologist-in-the-customer-room role. - You want to be a tier 1 support agent. Tier 1 work is part of the job and your job is to make less of it exist over time. - You are disengaged from the Bangladesh market or the regulatory and banking landscape. - You are not interested in compliance, financial services, or regulated technology. --- ## Why Anqa - Real equity — 2% ownership. Equity vests against agreed delivery milestones. You are coming in at the floor. - Live customers. Our first Bangladesh customer is in production cutover August 2026 — a deployed compliance platform serving a real institution. - Regulatory tailwind. AML compliance technology is becoming mandatory across the regulated financial sector in several of the markets we operate in. We are positioned for it. Path to leadership.** Within 12–18 months this role evolves into a salaried Bangladesh Customer Lead position with budget to build the team you will run. - Monthly dividends . Anqa is structured so that once revenue hits the dividend trigger, surplus profit is paid out to equity holders every month. No debt, no outside investors, no non-tech overhead. --- ## What Success Looks Like - The CEO is no longer the only technically credible person on Bangladesh customer calls — you are. - The customer knowledge base goes from zero to the first artefact a new customer is pointed at — and reduces inbound load by a measurable amount. - The same bug stops getting filed twice. - Customers describe Anqa support as a reason they stay with the platform. - Within 12 months you are leading customer operations in Bangladesh, with a team you have helped hire. --- ## How to Apply Submit your CV and a short note (5–8 sentences) covering: 1. Unlike basic chatbot implementations, you will focus on building "digital colleagues" that leverage persistent memory and autonomous skill creation to handle high-stakes business logic. Your primary mission is to integrate these agents into the core of our organization, moving beyond consumer messaging tools to establish deep connections with modern ERP environments, global trade solutions, and secure government and authority portals. You will ensure all systems are fully compliant with the EU AI Act and run on sovereign, self-hosted infrastructure. Skill Synthesis: Develop and refine autonomous skills using the agentskills.io standard, enabling agents to synthesize experience from complex enterprise tasks into reusable tools. MCP Standardization: Leverage the Model Context Protocol (MCP) as a universal standard to connect autonomous agents with external databases, APIs, and proprietary enterprise applications. Self-Evolution via GEPA: Implement the GEPA Self-Evolution system to optimize internal procedures and prompts based on execution logs, reducing operational overhead and token consumption. Must-Have Skills and Experience: Hermes Agent Mastery: Proven experience in configuring and scaling the Hermes Agent framework (including memory backends like HindSight) for persistent, session-spanning autonomy. Enterprise Integration Expert: Deep technical understanding of connecting AI agents to ERP infrastructures and global trade systems via secure APIs and microservices. S overeign Infrastructure: Strong commitment to local-first AI and digital sovereignty, with hands-on experience deploying models via vLLM or Ollama on self-hosted GPU clusters. Compliance Knowledge : Familiarity with the technical requirements of the EU AI Act and GDPR, specifically regarding transparency, auditability, and human-in-the-loop mechanisms in automated decision-making. Python Proficiency: Advanced software engineering skills in Python, utilizing async patterns and typed schemas (e.g. Pydantic) to build resilient agentic cycles. Nice to Have: Experience with LangGraph, dify, or Dagster for orchestrating multi-step, cross-departmental workflows. Familiarity with vector databases (e.g. Qdrant, PGVector) for high-performance retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) in corporate knowledge bases. Background in Infrastructure as Code for managing sovereign cloud deployments. jobs.title: Full-Stack Engineer – Angular + .NET (URGENT)
jobs.description: Openings: 7 Employment Type: Full-time Location: Dhaka, Bangladesh / India Experience Level: Mid Level About Ajentica Ajentica is an agentic AI and software engineering consultancy that helps ambitious organizations design, build and modernize complex digital products. Our teams work across healthcare, pharmacy software, HR technology and other enterprise domains where reliability, security and thoughtful product engineering matter. We are expanding one of our healthcare product engineering teams and are looking for four Full-Stack Engineers with strong Angular and .NET experience. You will work within an Ajentica delivery team to build and enhance modern clinical and scheduling capabilities used in a complex, data-sensitive environment. The Role As a Full-Stack Engineer at Ajentica, you will take ownership of production-grade features across the frontend, backend and integration layers. You will translate product requirements into secure, maintainable software; contribute to technical design; collaborate closely with product, UX, QA and DevOps colleagues; and help the team deliver at speed without compromising quality. This role is best suited to an engineer who is comfortable working with complex workflows, evolving requirements and systems where data privacy, auditability and operational reliability are essential. Key Responsibilities Design, build and maintain responsive web applications using Angular, TypeScript and CSS. Develop scalable backend services and APIs using C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core and Microservice. Deliver end-to-end features across user interfaces, business logic, data access and service integrations. Translate complex scheduling, calendar and clinical workflows into clear, reliable product experiences. Design and consume RESTful APIs and integrate with internal and third-party systems. Work with relational databases, write efficient queries and maintain sound data models. Contribute to solution design, technical estimation and engineering decisions. Write clean, testable and maintainable code supported by appropriate unit, integration and end-to-end testing. Participate in code reviews and help strengthen engineering standards across the team. Diagnose production issues, improve application performance and support reliable releases. Collaborate with product managers, designers, QA engineers, DevOps engineers and other stakeholders in an Agile delivery environment. Apply secure engineering practices when handling sensitive healthcare and personally identifiable information. Support documentation, knowledge sharing and the development of less-experienced engineers. Core Technical Requirements Strong professional experience in full-stack software development. Advanced experience with Angular, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS/SCSS and modern frontend architecture. Strong experience with C#, .NET and ASP.NET Core, Microservice. Experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs, service-layer components and distributed integrations. Strong knowledge of SQL and relational databases, preferably Microsoft SQL Server and PostgreSQL. Practical experience with Entity Framework Core or a comparable ORM. Good understanding of object-oriented design, SOLID principles and common software design patterns. Experience with authentication and authorization approaches such as OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect and role-based access control. Experience with automated testing frameworks for both frontend and backend applications. Proficiency with Git, pull-request workflows and modern CI/CD practices. Familiarity with cloud-based application delivery; Microsoft Azure experience is preferred. Ability to investigate ambiguous problems, communicate trade-offs and independently drive work to completion. Healthcare, PHI and HIPAA Experience – Preferred Prior experience building healthcare, clinical, pharmacy, electronic health record or other regulated software products will be strongly preferred. In particular, we value candidates who understand: HIPAA-aligned engineering practices and the responsibilities involved in handling Protected Health Information (PHI). Data minimization, least-privilege access and role-based authorization. Encryption of sensitive data in transit and at rest. Audit logging, traceability and secure handling of clinical or patient-related actions. Secure development practices, vulnerability management and disciplined production access. The use of de-identified, masked or synthetic data in non-production environments. Privacy-aware application design and the importance of preventing sensitive information from appearing in logs, error messages or unauthorized workflows. Candidates are not expected to act as compliance officers, but they must be able to translate security and privacy requirements into sound engineering decisions. Nice to Have AI first development approach. Experience building scheduling, calendar, appointment-management or clinical workflow products. Experience with microservices, event-driven architecture or asynchronous processing. Familiarity with Azure services such as App Service, Functions, Service Bus, Key Vault, Application Insights or Azure SQL. Experience with real-time functionality using SignalR, WebSockets or similar technologies. Understanding of healthcare interoperability standards such as HL7 or FHIR. Experience with Docker, containerized deployments and observability tooling. Familiarity with accessibility standards and responsive design for enterprise applications. Experience working with distributed, cross-functional or client-facing delivery teams. What We Look For Strong ownership and urgency, balanced with sound engineering judgement. Clear and proactive communication. The ability to understand the business and user context behind a technical requirement. A collaborative mindset and comfort giving and receiving constructive feedback. Attention to quality, privacy, security and operational detail. Adaptability in a fast-moving product and consulting environment. Why Join Ajentica Work on meaningful, technically challenging digital products. Contribute to modern healthcare software where engineering quality has real-world impact. Collaborate with experienced product, engineering, design and delivery professionals. Take visible ownership of important product capabilities from design through production. Grow within an ambitious international technology consultancy with a rapidly expanding delivery organization. ﻿ Ajentica is an equal-opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and evaluate candidates based on capability, experience and alignment with the role. You’ll work across the stack — Python services and APIs on the backend, React and TypeScript on the frontend — and take features from requirement through to production. The engineering problem is interesting. Our products work with large volumes of security telemetry, threat intelligence and risk data. Our users need to quickly answer questions like: What happened? What matters? Where should I investigate? What should I do next? That means the interfaces you build need to do more than look good. They need to turn complex data into something fast, clear and useful. You’ll work directly with our product team and security analysts to build those experiences. What you’ll do • Build and maintain backend APIs and services using Python, Django and Flask • Build React and TypeScript interfaces including dashboards, data tables, search, filtering and visualisations • Design and evolve database schemas as our products and data volumes grow • Optimise SQL queries and application performance • Build asynchronous and background processing workflows • Own features from technical design through development, testing, deployment and production support • Debug issues across frontend, backend and database layers • Write automated tests and participate in code reviews • Work directly with product and SOC analysts to turn real operational requirements into shipped features • Contribute to technical decisions as your ownership grows What we’re looking for • 2+ years of professional experience building production web applications • Strong Python skills with production experience using Django, Flask or a similar Python web framework • Strong React and modern JavaScript fundamentals • Experience working with TypeScript • Experience designing and consuming REST APIs • Solid SQL, relational database and data modelling skills • Experience with background or asynchronous processing such as Celery, task queues or similar technologies • Good HTML and CSS fundamentals, including responsive interfaces • Experience using Git, Docker and CI/CD as part of a development workflow • Basic understanding of cloud infrastructure such as AWS S3, EC2 and Lambda • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills • Good written and spoken English — our teams collaborate across countries and time zones • Ability to work on-site from our Dhaka office Nice to have • Experience building dashboards or data-heavy applications • Data visualisation or charting libraries • Tailwind, MUI, shadcn/ui or another component/design system • WebSockets, Server-Sent Events or other real-time application patterns • Redis, caching and application performance optimisation • Deeper AWS/Azure, Kubernetes or infrastructure-as-code experience • Exposure to AI-powered features, LLM APIs, embeddings or RAG • Golang experience • An interest in cybersecurity, threat intelligence, SIEM or security data • Open-source contributions or personal projects you can show us You do not need to be a cybersecurity expert. We would rather hire a strong engineer who is curious about security than a security specialist with weak software engineering fundamentals. Why join Pipeline? You won’t be limited to implementing isolated tickets. You’ll have the opportunity to take a problem through the complete product lifecycle: Analyst problem → technical design → database → API → interface → production You’ll work with experienced engineers and directly with the security analysts using what you build. As you grow, we want you to take ownership of increasingly important parts of the platform. You’ll also gain exposure to cybersecurity, threat intelligence and AI-assisted security products — areas that are becoming increasingly important to modern software engineering. Interview process Introductory conversation – 30 minutes Take-home project for selected candidates Technical interview covering frontend, backend and system design – 60–75 minutes Final conversation with the hiring manager and Dhaka office visit About Pipeline Pipeline is a cybersecurity company headquartered in Tokyo, with operations across Asia and an R&D team in Dhaka. We build our own cybersecurity products and work with real-world security telemetry, threat intelligence and risk data. Interested? Send us your CV along with a short note about something you’ve built.
